newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shougang Grand sells HK$113 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Shougang Grand sells HK$113 mln property.

text.p: Property investment concern Shougang Concord Grand (Group) Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell some of its residential properties in Sai Kung in Hong Kong's New Territories for a total HK$113.30 million.
The company said it would sell eight houses in Billows Villa in Sai Kung to independent third party Profit Chance Development Ltd.
It said a net profit of HK$9.0 million would be realised from the disposal and that the proceeds would be used for reinvestment in other properties in Hong Kong.
